title: Parasite SEO vs Partnerships: how Jacky Chou runs 50/50 publisher deals and humanized AI content
summary: Jacky Chou explains how he uses public parasite SEO as a tester to attract publisher partnerships, then runs 50/50 deals with content ownership and residuals. He covers humanizing AI content, limiting publishing velocity, and monetizing rankings with 40%+ commissions via Amazon.

principles.text: Less-known parasite sites still work until Google notices them
principles.quote: the quote unquote private or less well-known parasite sites that I've tested which I did a video on recently those still work like a charm so as long as Google doesn't know really know about it just yet it's still easy to abuse

principles.text: Standard publisher deals are 50/50 with no negotiation
principles.quote: contracts it's it's always 50/50 there's no negotiation you could probably get away with less

principles.text: Own the content and keep two-year residuals on termination
principles.quote: we own the content to to the stuff we create and we get two-year residuals if they want to terminate

principles.text: Humanize and re-optimize AI content before publishing
principles.quote: we humanize and then reoptimize first so we make sure it passes all AI detector tests

principles.text: Keep publishing velocity modest on partner sites
principles.quote: we've had certain sites partnership sites where we would blast like thousands of Articles a month and then that would get hit really quickly versus where we did like 50 to 100 a month totally okay

principles.text: Monetize rankings at 40%+ commissions, Amazon over custom affiliates
principles.quote: we try to get paid at least 40% commissions on the articles that we rank for and we only go to Amazon all these like custom affiliate guys
